base_game: Eclipse: Second Dawn for the Galaxy
one_line: A heavy sci-fi 4X game where each player leads a galactic species, exploring hex sectors, researching technology, designing ships and fighting for influence over eight or nine rounds.

A solo and co-op fantasy adventure that blends deck-building, exploration and puzzle-like turns as each player leads a Mage Knight across a modular map toward scenario goals such as conquering cities.
A two-sided Star Wars miniatures game where one player commands the Empire against a team of Rebel heroes, played as story-driven campaign missions or as head-to-head skirmishes.
A deck-building race game by Reiner Knizia where each player leads an expedition across a modular jungle map, buying and playing cards to reach the legendary city of gold first.

base_game: Legendary: A Marvel Deck Building Game
one_line: A cooperative Marvel deck-building game where players recruit heroes to stop a Mastermind from completing an evil Scheme before the heroes are overrun.
